metadata.title: Mid-Century Western Album Cover Layout
useCases: Retro portrait photography with industrial backgrounds

retrievalProfile.description: A mid-century masculine portrait layout featuring a subject in warm earth tones against a cool blue sky and industrial machinery, utilizing heavy slab-serif display type.
triggerTerms: slab serif typography on blue background

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a man in a rust-colored suede jacket positioned in the foreground, offset to the right, with a vintage steam locomotive in the background to the left, all set against a clear blue sky with minimal foliage.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm foreground subject vs. cool blue background
Industrial machinery balanced by human presence
Heavy block typography anchored in the upper left quadrant
Diagonal line created by the subject's arm leading toward the center

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is a medium-close-up, positioned in the right two-thirds of the frame, leaning forward.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man's face and the bright rust-colored jacket serve as the primary anchors.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the bold text in the top left, moves down to the locomotive, then across to the subject's face and down his arm.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper left quadrant provides negative space for the primary typographic elements.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the jacket and sky; mid-tones in the skin and locomotive.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to earth tones, blue, and primary yellow/white for text

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and condensed sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Thick, blocky serifs for display text
Tight letter spacing for the main title
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold white slab serif paired with a smaller yellow slab serif for emphasis.

preserve: Color contrast between white and yellow

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif weight and blunt terminals.
Provides the correct mid-century slab serif aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a man in a rust-colored suede jacket in the foreground, offset to the right. In the background to the left, place a vintage steam locomotive. The setting is outdoors under a clear blue sky with a few trees on the far right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold slab-serif text in the upper left corner. The top line should be white and the second line should be yellow. Include thin horizontal lines and a small text block below the main titles.

verificationChecks: Is the jacket a warm rust/orange tone?
Is the text left-aligned in the upper left quadrant?
Is the sky a clear, saturated blue?
Is the locomotive visible but secondary to the man?

mustAchieve: Clear separation between subject and background

postGenerationChecks: Check that the slab serif is sufficiently heavy.
Ensure the rust color of the jacket pops against the blue sky.
Verify the asymmetrical balance between the man and the train.
Confirm the text is legible against the sky background.
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject(Man in Suede) + Background(Steam Engine + Blue Sky) + Typography(Heavy Slab Serif, Left-Aligned) = Mid-Century Western Aesthetic
